issues.where: Near foreground across the lower third, strongest from bottom center to lower right
issues.what: The surface is more sharply outlined and locally re-patterned. Thick dark seams and polished, high-contrast cell centers replace the softer, more directionally stretched texture in the target, making the foreground read flatter and more metallic.
issues.fix: Match the target's softer near-field focus and diagonal texture flow, especially at lower right. Reduce the contrast on the seams without smoothing away detail at the horizon.

issues.where: Crops D, E and F; foreground in G
issues.what: The large foreground cells have harder reddish-black borders and more isolated specular peaks. E and F lose the target's continuous diagonal stretch, while D and G lose some of its smooth falloff into foreground blur.
issues.fix: Restore the directional stretch and focus gradient. Soften the seam edges and blend the bright cell centers into the surrounding texture.

issues.where: Central sunspot in A and the adjacent rim in F
issues.what: The black opening looks slightly fuller and more uniformly black, especially at its left end, and the bright radial fibers look harder against it.
issues.fix: Bring back the target's less uniform shadow and ragged edge, and ease the contrast of the brightest radial fibers.

issues.where: Sky above the horizon, including the space inside the main arch
issues.what: Individual stars are brighter, larger and more conspicuous against the black, competing with the finer plasma strands.
issues.fix: Dim and tighten the brightest star points while retaining the diffuse dust band and deep sky blacks.

issues.where: Sky in B, C, H and I, and behind the inner strands in A
issues.what: The field has more prominent white and blue pinpoints, so the dust lane and dark space behind the arches read less softly than in the target.
issues.fix: Lower stellar peaks and shrink the larger points without removing the target's faint dust structure.

issues.where: Plasma strands in H and the horizon around both footpoints in G and I
issues.what: The filaments are a little more crisply separated from their glow, and the footpoint highlights sit more starkly against the amber horizon.
issues.fix: Soften just the hottest filament edges and the transition out of both footpoints, keeping the arch and horizon geometry.

issues.where: Star field and dust band on both sides of the disk
issues.what: More of the stars stand out as bright hard pinpoints, while the right-hand orange dust knots are slightly less distinct.
issues.fix: Restrain the point highlights and recover the diffuse warm structure in the right-hand dust band.

issues.where: Sky in B, C, D, E, H and I
issues.what: Larger and brighter star points are visible at crop scale. The diffuse copper structures in I look flatter next to them.
issues.fix: Reduce star size and peak brightness, and restore the target's dusty warm-to-cool contrast in I.

issues.where: Disk center and bright active regions in A and F; upper disk in G
issues.what: Bright granules and filaments read slightly crisper and more individually outlined, with some loss of the target's softer transitions from white-hot cores to amber surface.
issues.fix: Ease local sharpening and blend the core highlights more gradually into the gold and rust midtones.

issues.where: Upper-right, lower-left and lower-right limb loops in C, D and E
issues.what: Some of the red and gold prominence edges are more defined against the creamy corona, and the very faint strands are less integrated into its haze.
issues.fix: Blend the outer prominence edges back into the soft coronal rays and retain the fine, low-contrast strands.
